item.title: Agent 入口
item.summary: 本轮研究单元只判断 Microsoft、Google、OpenAI 办公 Agent 商业化公开证据链的完整度，不外推入口控制权、商业能力领先或市场份额。Google 在'付费规模'与'持续使用'两环各有一段财报级披露，但口径未独立定义；Microsoft 与 OpenAI 的同口径披露暂为 UNKNOWN。

synthesis.outlook_12_36m: 未来 12–36 个月，三家将沿'披露口径收紧+协议层控制权争夺'两条轴线展开。Google 若能在 2026 财年内披露 Gemini Enterprise 与 Workspace 的去重后独立企业付费基数与席位数净增，将锁定入口领先；OpenAI 须在 2026 年内补齐 Frontier 客户的留存与第三方核验，否则生产结果叙事的可信度将持续被 AWS/IDC 类反证稀释；Microsoft 必须在 10-Q 或分析师电话会披露 Copilot/Copilot Agents 的独立付费席位或 ARR，否则其商业化证据链将长期停留在'客户证言'层。MCP 2026 年 7 月的史上最大更新叠加 Google 主导的 ARD 规范，将把入口标准的争夺从产品功能上移到协议治理层。
synthesis.strategic_summary: 本轮研究单元只判断 Microsoft、Google、OpenAI 办公 Agent 商业化公开证据链的完整度，不外推入口控制权、商业能力领先或市场份额。Google 在'付费规模'与'持续使用'两环各有一段财报级披露，但口径未独立定义；Microsoft 与 OpenAI 的同口径披露暂为 UNKNOWN。
synthesis.why_now: 截至本轮检索时点，办公 Agent 正在从'附加能力'切换为'默认入口'：Google 已将 Gemini 高级能力内嵌 Workspace 全商业套餐，Anthropic 把 Claude Code 纳入 Premium 订阅，OpenAI 把 Frontier 包装为'企业级 Agent 平台'，MCP/ARD 协议层在 2026 年 7 月迎来史上最大更新，意味着行业级入口标准正在成型。同时 AWS 调研给出强反证：2025 年仅不足 7% 企业有任一 Agent 用例进入完整生产，且 57% 在生产中遭遇'自信但错误'，这使得'哪家证据链最完整'从营销话术问题变成可被审计的合规问题，必须在本时点锁定差距。

evidence.source_quote: Despite just half (50 percent) of organizations reporting having 10 or more agents in production in 2025 and healthy development pipelines via third-party applications, moving beyond the pilot stage remains a challenge. Less than seven percent are in full production with at least one use case—which demonstrates a clear and urgent need for deployment accelerators, as well as embedded agents that can more easily plug into existing stacks.

evidence.source_quote: The [Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/docs/getting-started/intro), the open standard that has quietly become the connective tissue between AI agents and the world's software, is getting its largest update since Anthropic [released it](https://www.anthropic.com/news/model-context-protocol) twenty months ago — a sweeping architectural revision that its maintainers and backers say finally makes agentic AI ready for massive enterprise production deployments.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: MCP协议在2026年7月迎来史上最大更新，目标是让Agent在真实软件环境里可发现、可调用，是行业级入口标准的成型信号

evidence.source_quote:
The central finding is a context gap — the distance between how confidently enterprise agents answer and how reliable the context beneath them actually is. A majority of enterprises (57%) report that in the past six months their AI agents produced confident but wrong answers they traced to missing or inconsistent business context, and more than half of those said it happened more than once. This is not a fringe failure: retrieval is the primary context source for 38% of enterprises, more than any other approach, so when retrieval is thin or inconsistent, the errors it produces are wearing the agent’s authority. The infrastructure to fix it is being built — 58% already run or are building a governed semantic layer — but for most it is not yet in production.
This is the report’s defining number. A majority of enterprises (57%) have already had an AI agent produce a confident, wrong answer they traced to bad context — wrong metrics, stale definitions, or missing documents — and more than half of those have seen it happen more than once. Only 28% report no such failure, and a small remainder either don’t run agents on enterprise data or don’t trace root cause closely enough to know.
Retrieval is the backbone of enterprise context. For 38% of organizations, RAG over documents or a vector index is the primary way agents understand the business — nearly twice the share of the next approach, a governed semantic layer or ontology (21%). Mixed approaches (14%), direct live-system queries (10%), and long-context loading (6%) fill out the rest, and only 2% let agents run on the model’s general knowledge alone. The concentration matters in light of Finding 1: because so much enterprise context flows through retrieval, the quality of that retrieval is the quality of the answer. When RAG is the default source, thin retrieval is not an edge case — it is the main failure surface.
The fix for the context gap is under construction. Well over half of enterprises (58%) either run a governed semantic layer in production (25%) or are piloting and building one (34%), and a further 17% are actively evaluating — meaning three-quarters are engaged with the idea in some form. But the balance is telling: more are building than have shipped, so for most enterprises the shared, governed definition layer that would prevent the "confident but wrong" failures of Finding 1 is still a work in progress. The semantic layer is the industry’s answer to inconsistent context; this wave catches it mid-construction, ambition well ahead of production.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: 企业Agent在生产中近六成(57%)出现'自信但错误'，根因被归为上下文缺失/不一致，是入口环节可信度的反证

evidence.source_quote:
文章披露，目前Anthropic内部95%的商业数据分析请求已经由Claude自动完成，整体准确率约为95%。
仅仅一个月之后，准确率就下降到了约65%。造成下降的主要原因并不是Claude的模型能力发生了退化，而是业务数据模型持续变化，供Claude使用的Skill文档没有同步更新。
直到Anthropic把Skill文件和数据模型放进同一个代码仓库，并要求数据模型变更时同步修改相关文档，准确率才重新得到控制。
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Anthropic内部95%商业数据分析由Claude完成、约95%准确率，但数据模型变化而Skill未同步后准确率跌至65%，揭示Agent持续使用的衰减风险

evidence.source_quote:
目前，Model Context Protocol（MCP） 等协议定义了 AI Agent 如何调用工具，而 ARD 关注的是整个生命周期中更早的一个环节——Agent 如何发现这些工具。ARD 并非用于取代现有标准，而是作为一层独立的资源发现机制，与不同框架和服务提供商兼容，并可与现有标准协同工作。
ARD 规范引入了两个核心概念：Catalog（资源目录） 和 Registry（注册中心）。组织可以在自己的域名下发布一个机器可读的 ai-catalog.json 文件，用于描述可提供的能力，例如工具、API、Skill 以及 Agent Endpoint。Registry 则负责聚合这些 Catalog，并允许 Agent 根据任务意图搜索所需能力，而无需依赖预先写死的集成逻辑或静态 Endpoint 列表。借助这种机制，Agent 可以跨组织发现相关资源，同时仍然兼容 MCP、OpenAPI 等现有执行标准。
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Google联合多家厂商发布Agentic Resource Discovery(ARD)规范，在MCP之上叠加Catalog/Registry资源发现层，强化其入口治理角色
